01
Pull. Release. Ride.

Pull down to stretch the slingshot, then release. On a keyboard, hold and release Space. Quick launch gives 75% power. Drag left or right, or use ← → / A D. The finish arch marks the end of each route. Finishing unlocks your next mountain.

02
Collect and progress

Follow coin trails to earn new riders. Look for blue diamonds above ramps. Each diamond location, first clear, and first 3-medal reward pays only once.

03
Take a calculated risk

Ramps launch you into a gravity-driven jump. Steer gently in the air. Tap SPIN or press Space before the apex, then land for a bonus. Tall trees still need dodging.

04
Ride the power-ups

M = coin magnet (9s). S = one-hit shield (15s). >> = nitro (3s). 2x = double pickup coins (9s). Skim hazards to charge another boost.

P / Esc to pause · R to retry · 3D quality can be reduced
